Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor

Class AdvancedTextEditorPanel

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
javax.swing.JComponent
javax.swing.JPanel
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor.AdvancedTextEditorPanel
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible, ExtensionsCard.Host, FindReplaceBar.Host, ProjectCard.Host, RecentCard.Host, SettingsCard.Host
public class AdvancedTextEditorPanel extends JPanel implements FindReplaceBar.Host, SettingsCard.Host, RecentCard.Host, ExtensionsCard.Host, ProjectCard.Host
Espresso, the Advanced Text Editor: a production plain-text and source-code editor for the lg3d desktop, built as one plain-Swing panel that serves both desktops. In the 3D desktop the AdvancedTextEditor wrapper hosts it on a SwingNode inside a Frame3D through TitledSwingWindow; in the 2D/Swing desktop Desktop2DAppRegistry.PANEL_APPS opens this very panel as an MDI internal frame. Because it can be captured offscreen, every secondary surface (find & replace, settings, recent files, extensions) is an in-panel card or bar — never a popup or a modal dialog, and selectors are JLists, not combo boxes.

Feature set. Multi-tab editing with dirty tracking and close confirmation; safe file IO (size and binary guards, BOM and strict-UTF-8 charset detection, per-file line endings, atomic saves that preserve POSIX permissions); regex or literal find / replace with live match counts, wrap-around navigation and Go-to-Line; single-undo-step Replace All; debounced regex syntax highlighting for 16 built-in languages; line-number gutter with current-line and bracket-match highlighting; smart auto-indent; soft or hard tabs; word wrap; zoom; light and dark themes; persisted settings and recent files; merge-on-type undo (a typed burst is one undo step); a west ProjectTreePanel project file tree (re-rooted on the project of the document being edited, double-click opens a file) and a south OutputConsole where extension tool actions land their output; and a TextEditorExtension SPI loaded through META-INF/services, shipped with a bundled "Text Tools" extension (sort lines, strip trailing whitespace, timestamp, case transforms).

Security. The editor never executes file content, refuses binaries and over-sized files, writes through temp-file-plus-atomic-move so a crash can't truncate the original, copies the target's permissions onto the replacement, and isolates misbehaving extensions behind a Throwable containment boundary in ExtensionBroker.
